question: What supreme attainment results from knowing the teaching that replaces mere counting?
premises: There is a knowledge to be attained
The practitioner who knows it acts accordingly
The result is reaching the rare abode of Brahman
inference: By knowing this, the practitioner attains the hard-to-reach abode of Brahman.
plain_english: Having known which, the practitioner goes to the hard-to-attain abode of Brahman.
